description: The signed-in person's StockMap watchlists: each list's stocks with the model's published call on each (the same call every reader sees), the calls that changed last night first. Each answer carries the not-advice line and the run date.
name: my_watchlists

not_landed.description: True: tonight's run has not landed yet, so this is the previous run
not_landed.title: Not Landed

changed.description: Its stocks whose call changed last night
changed.title: Changed

read_only.description: Beyond the plan's number of lists: it keeps its stocks, takes no more
read_only.title: Read Only

stocks.description: The calls that changed last night first, then in the list's order
stocks.title: Stocks

call.description: The model's call, as the watchlist shows it; None: no call this run
call.title: Call

changed_from.description: The call before last night, when last night changed it
changed_from.title: Changed From

not_advice.default: The model's track-recorded read, not financial advice.
not_advice.title: Not Advice

title: My watchlists
